title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
description_plain:
Design high-reliability automotive powertrain assemblies, validate GD&T tolerances per ASME Y14.5, and supervise CNC tooling manufacture.

Requirements:
- 6+ years of mechanical design engineering in an automotive or industrial setting.
- Professional fluency in SolidWorks 3D CAD modeling and GD&T drafting.
- Bachelor of Engineering / Technology in Mechanical Engineering.
